reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface theme/surface customization for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. Evidence from the README and manifest shows it is packaged as a DSH bundle with client-side registration and settings/UI hooks to apply and toggle a beige visual skin, with no declared backend, file, terminal, or external service workflow logic.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的主题插件，用于提供米黄色视觉皮肤，并通过客户端注入与设置入口控制外观风格。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme plugin that provides a beige visual skin and applies it through client-side injection with a user-facing settings/toggle integration.

capabilities: Provides a DSH web client visual theme plugin
Defines and registers a beige skin via client-side theme integration
Exposes a runtime skin toggle entry and settings hook for user control

reasons.code: README describes the package as a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin and lists beige-theme visual features only
package.json includes a DSH client web bundle with immediate injection configuration and theme-related client dependencies
Repository tree includes lib/client.js and cordis.patch.yml for theme/client registration
